endpoint: QQuickWindow.afterRendering render-callback proxy; not presentation FPS, input-to-present or scanout

change.reuse_layer: NodeSampleMemo: byte-bounded (16 MiB declared ceiling) LRU of the exact float32 endpoint pair and provenance per (source set, time window, node), plus per-node land decisions per shoreline quality. stage_wind prefills cached endpoints and only samples remaining nodes; stage_field consults the land memo. Only finite pairs are stored, so holes and mask semantics are unchanged.
change.recentring_layer: GribViewportModel watches the same REFILL_VIEW_FACTOR guard the scheduler prefers. While a ready field is presented and the guard is no longer covered, it queues exactly one deterministic re-centred window: one field lattice ahead along the camera's direction of motion, through the existing two-slot pipeline and generation keys. A stationary camera re-centres nothing.
change.cancellation_layer: The active request is no longer cancelled by a time-window or land-policy change; only close() and an explicitly cancelled request set its cancel event. A 30 Hz pan or time sweep therefore cannot starve the single worker. Cancellation still means the field may never publish or be retained.
change.retention_layer: A completed field whose key is no longer the desired key is retained in the store and a back slot, counted as superseded_retained, and never adopted or published at that moment; a later update that asks for that demand serves it. It is not added to rejected_generations or published_generations.
change.temporal_lookahead_layer: When a ready field is presented, no work is in flight, and the camera is spatially stationary, the worker prepares exactly one deterministic N+1 forecast window: the interval whose start is the presented field's after boundary, on the same spatial window. It uses the existing two-slot pipeline, skips a target already resident, and never runs for a moving camera, so spatial re-centring keeps priority. This is one step, not #67-style time residency.
change.semantics: The memo is a pure function of the same inputs; a new stage_wind test asserts a memoized shifted window is bit-identical to cold staging, and a land-memo test asserts a stored False is a hit. A superseded field is only reused when it actually covers the later demand. The application path passes no memo and is byte-identical.

limits: The 11/18 time result is stable across two independent native runs after retention plus one-step lookahead (runs 5 and 6); the retention-only run was 16/18.
